blocks.title: Explain the important decision
blocks.text: Break on the array access, Step Into Sum and watch i, marks.Length and total. Diagnose the failing state before editing the loop condition.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace a method call
blocks.text: static int Sum(int[] marks) { int total = 0; for (int i=0; i<=marks.Length; i++) total += marks[i]; return total; }

blocks.title: Worked example · Pause and inspect
blocks.text: Call Sum with [4,6]. Step Into enters the method; Step Over a call would run it without following its internal statements. Watch total=0, Length=2 and i=0.

blocks.title: Worked example · Locate the first invalid access
blocks.text: At i=0 total becomes 4; at i=1 it becomes 10. The faulty test allows i=2, but valid indexes are 0 and 1. The next array access fails.
